name: Prevent layout shifts with aspect ratio
text: Prevent layout shifts with aspect ratio Set `aspect-ratio` so nearby content does not jump while an image loads.

name: Balance heading text for easier reading
text: Balance heading text for easier reading Use `text-balance` for headings and `text-pretty` for body copy.

name: Align numbers with tabular-nums
text: Align numbers with tabular-nums Use `tabular-nums` to align numbers in tables and data-heavy UI.

name: Use 44px touch targets for accessibility
text: Use 44px touch targets for accessibility Give buttons and controls a touch target of at least 44 by 44px.

name: Match border radius on nested elements
text: Match border radius on nested elements Set the nested element's radius to the parent's radius minus its padding. Formula: `inner radius = outer radius - padding`

name: Add scale feedback to pressed buttons
text: Add scale feedback to pressed buttons Add subtle press feedback with `:active` and a scale near 0.96.

name: Animate popovers from their trigger
text: Animate popovers from their trigger Animate each popover from the control that opened it.

name: Group content with spacing, not dividers
text: Group content with spacing, not dividers Use spacing to group related content before adding divider lines.

name: Preview the next item in scroll lists
text: Preview the next item in scroll lists Show 16 to 32px of the next item to make horizontal scrolling clear.

name: Use neutral borders around images
text: Use neutral borders around images Use a thin neutral outline instead of a tinted ring.

name: Truncate long titles in small spaces
text: Truncate long titles in small spaces Use `line-clamp` or `truncate` when space is tight.

name: Improve contrast for muted text
text: Improve contrast for muted text Give muted text enough color contrast to stay easy to read.

name: Avoid scale-zero entrance animations
text: Avoid scale-zero entrance animations Start entrance animations near 95% size instead of scaling up from zero.

name: Match loading skeletons to real content
text: Match loading skeletons to real content Match loading skeletons to the content they replace, and skip spinners when possible.

name: Limit each view to one accent color
text: Limit each view to one accent color Use one accent per view. Keep secondary actions neutral.

name: Keep body text lines easy to read
text: Keep body text lines easy to read Keep text lines between 60 and 75 characters for easier reading.

name: Use shadows to show visual depth
text: Use shadows to show visual depth Use shadows to show depth. Use borders to show structure.

name: Add visible keyboard focus rings
text: Add visible keyboard focus rings Use `:focus-visible` to keep keyboard focus clear and visible.

name: Show form errors next to each field
text: Show form errors next to each field Put each validation error directly below its field.

name: Add visible labels to every form field
text: Add visible labels to every form field Use a visible label. Do not use placeholder text as the only label.

name: Give empty states one clear action
text: Give empty states one clear action Give an empty state one clear action, not just an explanation.

name: Use sentence case for UI labels
text: Use sentence case for UI labels Write labels in sentence case, not all caps.

name: Never use color alone for status
text: Never use color alone for status Add text or an icon so status is never shown by color alone.

name: Use ease-out for entrance animations
text: Use ease-out for entrance animations Use `ease-out` for entrances. `ease-in` feels slow when something opens.

name: Align icons by eye for better balance
text: Align icons by eye for better balance Nudge icons when geometric centering does not look visually balanced.

name: Match icon stroke weight to text
text: Match icon stroke weight to text Use a 2px stroke beside semibold text and a 1.5px stroke beside regular text.

name: Use outline icons for default states
text: Use outline icons for default states Use outline icons by default. Use a fill for the active state.

name: Avoid glow effects on primary buttons
text: Avoid glow effects on primary buttons Avoid glow effects on primary buttons; use contrast and spacing instead.

name: Animate icon state changes smoothly
text: Animate icon state changes smoothly Cross-fade changing icons with opacity, scale, and blur for smoother feedback.

name: Add space between nearby controls
text: Add space between nearby controls Leave about 12px between nearby bordered controls.

name: Keep full-width buttons inside page margins
text: Keep full-width buttons inside page margins Keep full-width buttons inside the page margins, not edge to edge.

name: Use tighter line height for headings
text: Use tighter line height for headings Use a line height near 1.1 for short headings.

name: Adjust letter spacing for large text
text: Adjust letter spacing for large text Large display text often needs slightly tighter letter spacing.

name: Confirm destructive actions before they run
text: Confirm destructive actions before they run Ask for confirmation before deleting data or taking an irreversible action.

name: Fade the edges of scrollable lists
text: Fade the edges of scrollable lists Use a `mask-image` fade to show where a scrollable list continues.

name: Stagger hero animations on first load
text: Stagger hero animations on first load Stagger hero animations by about 100ms on first load, not during routine interactions.

name: Keep exit animations short and subtle
text: Keep exit animations short and subtle Keep exit animations short with a small `translateY` movement.

name: Show nearby tooltips faster
text: Show nearby tooltips faster Show nearby tooltips faster after the first tooltip opens.

name: Use interruptible CSS transitions
text: Use interruptible CSS transitions Use CSS transitions for interactive open and close states.

name: Avoid repeated animations in routine UI
text: Avoid repeated animations in routine UI Animate first-load entrances, but keep repeated actions like tab switches instant.

name: Use ease-out instead of springs for feedback
text: Use ease-out instead of springs for feedback Use `ease-out` for toggles and toasts because springs can wobble.

name: Fade menus out when they close
text: Fade menus out when they close Close menus with a short fade. Do not move them far off screen.

name: Reserve brand colors for links and actions
text: Reserve brand colors for links and actions Keep headings neutral. Use the brand color for links and actions.

name: Use solid modal backdrops instead of blur
text: Use solid modal backdrops instead of blur Use a solid modal backdrop instead of blur to avoid expensive full-screen rendering.

name: Fade overflowing text instead of clipping it
text: Fade overflowing text instead of clipping it Fade long labels instead of cutting them off with a hard ellipsis.

name: Use matching enter and exit animations
text: Use matching enter and exit animations Use matching enter and exit animations so a surface feels connected.

name: Soften label changes with a short blur
text: Soften label changes with a short blur Add a short blur when labels change to avoid a distracting visual flash.
